verdict.rationale: Greptile ships a per-comment 'Fix with your Agent' button and a 'Fix All' button that send file paths, line numbers, and suggested code directly to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Conductor, or Devin, plus an official MCP server (confirmed working via runtime probe) letting agents fetch unaddressed PR comments and apply fixes natively inside Claude Code/Cursor/Codex/VS Code. This directly matches the story's request for both copyable fix prompts and direct agent integration. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation specifically of the fix-handoff or MCP flow (community evidence covers general review quality, not this specific feature).
